timingDefinitions.endToEndTurnTiming: Native scored turn latency in milliseconds, covering non-null observations.
timingDefinitions.publicationTiming: Synchronous scheduling from shadow journal schedulingMs.
timingDefinitions.backgroundTiming: Per-turn shadow work from shadow journal elapsedMs.
timingDefinitions.p50Ms: Median of sorted samples, averaging the two middle values for an even count.
timingDefinitions.p95Ms: Nearest rank, selecting the smallest value at or above 95% cumulative count.
